title: CiviqPass: Spanish nationality rules by origin
description: One row of the by-origin table. The by-situation table has the columns situation_code, situation_en, situation_es, situation_fr, situation_ar, years_residence, basis, applies_when, source_url, date_read.

origin_en.description: Name of the country of origin in English.

origin_es.description: Name of the country of origin in Spanish.

origin_fr.description: Name of the country of origin in French.

origin_ar.description: Name of the country of origin in Arabic.

years_residence.description: Years of legal, continuous residence before the application: 1, 2, 5 or 10.

years_basis.description: The article of the Código Civil behind the years.

dele_a2.description: exempt when the origin is on the exemption list, required otherwise.

dele_basis.description: The text that sets the DELE A2 rule for this row.

ccse.description: Always required for applicants over 18, in every row.

ccse_basis.description: The text that sets the CCSE rule.

documents_url_en.description: The CiviqPass page with the documents to request for this country of origin, in English; empty when there is no page yet.

fee_eur.description: The administrative fee for the application in euros, the same for every origin.

years_source_url.description: Official URL of the source for the years.

exams_source_url.description: Official URL of the source for the exams.

fee_source_url.description: Official URL of the source for the fee.

date_read.description: The day the sources of the row were last read (ISO date).

note_en.description: A caveat in English, empty when there is none.
